passage: Last Saturday afternoon, I met my old friend Liu Yang at a small coffee shop near the park. We studied together in college ten years ago, but we lost touch after graduation. I arrived first and ordered two cups of coffee. Ten minutes later, he walked in and waved to me with a big smile. We shook hands and started talking about our lives. He told me he moved to a new city and changed his job last year. I shared my news and told him about my plans to learn English. We laughed a lot and remembered funny stories from college. He showed me photos of his family on his phone. The waiter refilled our cups twice. Three hours passed very quickly. Before we left, we promised to meet again next month. I felt happy on the way home, because old friends make life warmer.

sentences.text: Ten minutes later, he walked in and waved to me with a big smile.
He told me he moved to a new city and changed his job last year.
We laughed a lot and remembered funny stories from college.

vocab.note: 固定搭配：失去联系；touch 的 ch 音别听成 k
再续杯；词尾 -ed 在 d 后读 /d/，容易吞音漏听
重音在第二音节 re-MEM-bered；和 remember 的发音差别只在尾音
